sourceUnitScope: 52 candidate lifecycle/frame tests plus 102 fixed historical contract/failure checks; historical defect assertions are not candidate acceptance.
typeScope: Repository check passed 398 production TS files and compiler consumer modes. The subsequently added final core-host fixture and corrected partial host configuration were separately checked with the package strict config. Public plugin declaration migration remains task04.
typeFinding: Initial source host required all existing thumbnails fields; actual Artplayer allows optional height, producing TS2345. Host view now permits partial SheetConfig while produced ThumbnailSheet and publish remain complete.
limitations: AUTO-THUMB-PIXEL-01 stays open: without native frame callbacks, first two cells remain diagnostic, not pixel acceptance.
Remaining task03 resource and fallback behavior work
Task04 public types and distribution declarations

packaging.scope: Yarn 1.22.22 actual archive file and entrypoint check; no isolated install or full distribution acceptance claimed
